$comment: Desired state of the suite realm (ADR 17 in dbqm45/pdi). Applied by `npm run identity -- configure`; each run makes Keycloak match this file and changes nothing else. Organizations, people and agents are not here: they are created by commands (and later by Admin Console).

publicClients.name: DI Decision MCP

offlineSession.why: MCP clients ask for offline_access (SEP-2207) and the sign-in fails without it; owner's decision 2026-11-25: allowed for this client only, ending after 24 h without use and after 14 days at most.

publicClients.why: Remote MCP server of pdi (dbqm45/pdi docs/plan-mcp-zdalny.md): Claude Code signs in with PKCE on a fixed loopback port (claude mcp add --client-id di-decision-mcp --callback-port 33418). No secret, no email (DI3); the token carries only DI Decision's roles and audience. Registered here instead of dynamic client registration, which would open anonymous registration in the realm.

serviceRoles.why: DI Channels finds the suite person behind a Slack user by e-mail

identityServiceAccount.why: the people lookup API reads users and their organizations; the admin console (docs/plan-admin-console.md) changes memberships and product roles (manage-users, view-clients), turns agents off and on (manage-clients) and reads and changes organization members — Keycloak 26.4 answers 403 to the organizations API without manage-realm, even to reads (checked 2026-11-25)
